description: Two noise drums, each a burst of sampled noise through a resonant filter, mixed to one output

params.text: Sets how long that voice rings after a trigger, from 10ms up to either 105ms or 2005ms depending on the switch between the knobs
Sets the pitch of that voice's noise, clocking the sample and hold between 80Hz and 8000Hz and sweeping the filter with it
Picks the decay range both voices work in: 10ms to 105ms in one position, 10ms to 2005ms in the other

inputs.text: A gate above 0.5V restarts that voice's decay
Adds to that voice's decay setting, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to that voice's pitch setting, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
